summary: Confirmed $50 RV nightly (page (c) 2026), 65 sites to 40 ft, 40 full-hookup sites, May 1-Oct 30, phone 315-389-4771. Added 50 A, booking by phone/contact form (half prepaid, non-refundable), dump, laundry, office WiFi; weekly/monthly/seasonal rates in fees.note. Long-stay tests pass: nightly rate on its own site + phone, no posted RV minimum, no homes/lots for sale (monthly $500 and seasonal $1,200 are offered; no seasonal-site count published). $50 is at, not over, the gate; nearest gateway Lake Placid 86 km; family has not stayed. Note trimmed of counts/rate/length/season/RV Life line and the stale Campendium caveat (the operator's site is current, (c) 2026). Not stated: showers (bathhouses only), pull-throughs.
